inputs.text: [excited] Thair… ih… zeen… oh… saurus. [curious] In ancient Greek, "therizino" means to scythe, to cut grass — like a giant curved blade. [playful] And "saurus" means lizard.
[amazed] The scythe lizard, with a real scythe?
[happily] Exactly. [confident] It lived in Mongolia, in the Gobi Desert, [amazed] seventy million years ago.
[curious] And were there scary dinosaurs out there too?
[playful] Oh yes! [confident] Tarbosaurus, T. rex's cousin, lived right nearby.
